name: Google Sheets
description: Read and write Google Sheets from a column. Connect your Google account once, then select which spreadsheets GTM Grid may open — it can only ever touch the files you pick.

methods.label: Append Row
methods.description: Append a row to the end of a sheet. `values` is a LIST OF ROWS, so a single row is `[["Acme", "acme.com"]]` — the extra nesting is Google's shape, not a typo. `range` only needs to name the sheet tab (e.g. `Sheet1`); Google finds the first empty row itself. The spreadsheet must be one you selected when connecting.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet id (the long id in its URL). Must be a sheet you selected when connecting Google.

range.description: Sheet tab to append to, e.g. `Sheet1` or `Sheet1!A:D`

values.description: Rows to append. One row = [["cell one", "cell two"]]

valueInputOption.description: USER_ENTERED (default — Google parses numbers/dates/formulas) or RAW (store verbatim)

methods.label: Read Range
methods.description: Read a cell range and return its values as a list of rows. Use A1 notation, e.g. `Sheet1!A1:D50` for a block or `Sheet1!A2:A` for a whole column from row 2 down. Empty trailing cells are omitted by Google, so rows can be shorter than you expect.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet id (the long id in its URL). Must be a sheet you selected when connecting Google.

methods.label: Write Range
methods.description: Overwrite a specific cell range. `values` is a LIST OF ROWS, so writing one cell is `[["done"]]`. The range must match the shape of the data you send — writing a 2-cell row into `A1:A1` fails. To add data without overwriting anything, use Append Row instead.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet id (the long id in its URL). Must be a sheet you selected when connecting Google.

methods.label: List Sheet Tabs
methods.description: List the tabs in a spreadsheet. Mostly used to populate the sheet picker on the other methods, but callable directly to discover tab names.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet id (the long id in its URL)

fields.description: Partial-response mask. Defaults to sheets.properties so the reply stays small.
